book.name: Jon
book.title: Toto Thovuye Utuniye Jon Le Rorori

content: Jisas i naŋgo ghamberegha kaiwae
Jisas i utuvao utuutuke thiyake na e ghereiye, marae i voro e buruburu na i naŋgo iŋa, “Bwebwe, mbaŋa kaero ina gheke. U wovavwenyevwenyeŋa Naru, mbala Naru i wovavwenyevwenyeŋaŋge.
Kaiwae u vatomwewe na i mbaroŋaŋgiya gharɨgharɨke wolaghɨye na mbala i giya yawalɨ memeghabananiye weŋgiya thavala kaerova u vatomwewe.
Na yawalɨ memeghabananiye gharumwaru, thɨ ghareghareŋge ghanɨmberegha moli Loi emunjoru na Jisas Krais ghen va u variye.
Kaero ya wovavwenyevwenyeŋaŋge e yambane na ya vakathavao kaiwoma va u woveŋgo na ya kaiwoŋa.
E mbaŋake iyake Bwebwe, weiŋgu ghen ra yaku na u wovavwenyevwenyeŋaŋgo, ŋgoreiya va weiŋgu ghen ra yaku e vwenyevwenyena tɨne amba muyai yambaneke i yomara.”
Jisas i naŋgo gharaghambu kaiwanji
“Kaerova ya woraŋgiyaŋge weŋgiya thavala va u vaŋguŋgi e yambaneke tɨne na u giya e ghino. Ghen len gharɨgharɨ na u giya e ghino. Thɨ ghambugha ghalɨŋana,
na mbaŋake thɨ ghareghare bigibigike wolaghɨye u giya e ghino i mena e ghen.
Kaiwae kaerova ya utuŋa weŋgi iya utuutuma va u utugiyama weŋgo na thɨ wovatha. Thɨ ghareghare mbema emunjoru ya mena e ghen na thɨ loŋweghathɨ ghen va u variyeŋgo.
Ma ya naŋgo yambaneke gharɨgharɨniye kaiwanji, ko iyemaeŋge thavala va u giya e ghino kaiwanji, kaiwae thiye len gharɨgharɨ.
Thavala inanji e ghino ghenɨwe, na thavala inanji e ghen ghinowe, na thiye weŋgi gharɨgharɨke wolaghɨye ne thɨ thuwe lo vwenyevwenye.

E mbaŋake iyake kaero ne ya ghaona e ghen. Mane tembe ya yakuva e yambaneke, ko thiye mbowo ne thɨ yaku e yambaneke. O Bwebwe Boboma, idana le vurɨgheghe e tɨne u njimbukikiŋgi — idako iyako kaerova u giya e ghino — mbala thɨ tabo wabwi regha ŋgoreiya ghen na ghino, regha ghinda.

Mbaŋa vamba weiŋguyaŋgi idana vurɨghegheniye e tɨne ya njimbukikiŋgi, idana iyava u woveŋgona. Va ya njimbukikiŋgi na ma regha mun i ghawe, mbema regha eŋge vara vambe len renuwaŋa e tɨne na i vaidiya vuyowo na i vaemunjoruŋa buk le utu.”
“Ya ghaona e ghen vara mbaŋake iyake. Ko mbaŋa amba inaŋgu e yambaneke ya naŋgo ŋgoreiyako, na lo warari mbala i riyevanjara gharenji.
Kaero ya giya len utuna weŋgi na yambaneke i botewoŋgi, kaiwae thiye ma lenji renuwaŋa ŋgoreiya gharɨgharɨ e yambaneke lenji renuwaŋa, na ghino tembe ŋgoreiyeva.
Iya elo naŋgoke ma yaŋa u mbanɨ raŋgiyaŋgi e yambaneke, ko ya naŋgo eŋge e ghen na u njimbukikiŋgi weya tharɨ loloniye.
Thiye ma yambaneke gharɨgharɨniye, tembe ŋgoreiyeva ghino.
Ghalɨŋan i emunjoru! U vavaghare weŋgi ghalɨŋan mbala thɨ boboma emunjoru e ghen.
Ŋgoreiya va u variyeŋgo na ya mena e yambaneke, ya variyeŋgi na thɨ raŋgi e yambaneke.
Thiye kaiwanji ya ghatha raŋgiyaŋgo e ghen kaiwae nuwaŋguiya thiye tembe thɨ ghatha raŋgiyaŋgiva emunjoru e ghen.”
Jisas i naŋgo thavala thɨ loŋweghathɨ kaiwanji
“Lo naŋgoke ma mbe thiye eŋge kaiwanji, mbe ya naŋgova thavala ne thɨ loŋweghathɨŋgo thiyeko lenji utuutuko kaiwae,
mbala thiya wabwi na regha, ŋgoreiya Bwebwe ghen inan e ghino na ghino inaŋgu e ghen. Thiye mbala inanji weinda, iya kaiwae yambaneke mbala i loŋweghathɨ ghen va u variyeŋgo.
Vwenyevwenyeke va u giyake e ghino, kaero va ya giya weŋgi mbala thiye thɨ tubwe na regha ŋgoreiye ghen na ghino.
Ghino naŋgu weŋgi na ghen inan e ghino, mbala thɨ tabona regha moli, mbala yambaneke i ghareghare va u variyeŋgo na u gharethovuŋgi ŋgoreiya u gharethovuŋgo.”

“Bwebwe, nuwaŋguiya thavala va u giya e ghino, weiŋguyaŋgi na ghino aŋga inaŋgu thiye inanjiwe, mbala thɨ thuwe lo vwenyevwenye. Vwenyevwenyeko iyako va u giya e ghino kaiwae u gharethovuŋgo amba muyai yambaneke i yomara.”
“Bwebwe, thovuye gharavakatha, othembe yambaneke ma i ghareghareŋge, ko ghino eŋge ya ghareghareŋge na thiyeke thɨ ghareghare va u variyeŋgo.
Ya vakathaŋgi na thɨ ghareghareŋge, na ne ya vakathambele mbaŋake wolaghɨye, iya kaiwae mbala thɨ vegharethovu weŋgi ŋgoreiya ghen u gharethovuŋgo, na mbala ghino ya yaku weŋgi.”
